Name: Makeup As Accessories
Author: jinxiewinxie
Description:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cVhD9QJ.png[/img]


[b]Alternate Option [/b]keeps beard + earrings AND all colors are true-match:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/s3R60Ij.png[/img]


This mod replaces the the accessories and makes them into lipstick and blush options.

I've created two versions for each color palette/replacer mod, one for the base face and one for the round face + skirt mod ([url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/202]download it here[/url]).


[b]Download:
[/b]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/183/?tab=2&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodfiles%2F%3Fid%3D183&pUp=1]Download Here[/url] on the Nexus (just click the file name or "download manually" for whichever file you want to use. If you choose the round face version, be sure you've installed Alex_01's round face + skirt mod that I linked to above.


[b]Installation Instructions:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract the archive
[*]Go to Stardew Valley/Content/Characters/Farmer
[*]Replace the accessories.xnb file with the one from the download
[/list]
*You can easily create a backup of your original accessories.xnb file by renaming it to something silly. I do accessories.xnbOLD for myself.


[b]To use:
[/b]
Just start your game and click through the accessories options.
You'll notice that your mileage may vary for any lipsticks replacing accessories 2-8 because those ones are hardcoded to be shaded based on whichever hair color you choose. The other accessories, 9-20 are always true color though.
